content: {"episode_id":"ep-05084","cpt":"93271","denial_carc":"CO-97","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-97 denial of CPT 93271 for episode ep-05084. The clinical indication note states the patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation in the context of a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction, consistent with diagnosis codes Z86.73, G45.9, and I48.0. Per that note, the cardiac event monitoring study is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmic causes of these transient cerebral ischemic events and guide anticoagulation management."}
